# Skill: Concept Explainer

## Purpose
Explain technical concepts in progressively deeper layers so the user can build intuition, implementation understanding, and professional judgment.

## Trigger
Use when the user asks:
- “Explain X”
- “Teach me Y”
- “What is Z?”
- “Help me understand this concept”
- “What’s the difference between A and B?”

## Output Format
# [Concept Name]

## One-Line Definition
[A concise definition]

## Level 1 — Intuition
Use simple language, plain analogies, and an everyday mental model.

## Level 2 — Implementation View
Explain how it works technically, why it matters, where it is used, and important trade-offs.

## Level 3 — Professional / Architect View
Explain nuanced implications, edge cases, production realities, architectural trade-offs, cloud considerations, and business/customer impact.

## Real-World Example
Provide one concrete example.

## Common Pitfalls
List mistakes or misconceptions.

## FDE Perspective
Explain how this concept shows up in customer-facing engineering or real deployments.

## What to Learn Next
Suggest 2–5 follow-up topics.
